frame.style_template: .cds-popup-wrapper{position:fixed;top:0;right:0;bottom:0;left:0;display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;z-index:2000;opacity:0;background-color:rgba(0,0,0,0.75);transition:opacity 0.5s ease-in-out}.cds-popup-content{color:rgb(255,255,255);display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;align-items:center;position:relative;padding:20px;opacity:0;transition:opacity 0.5s ease-in-out;row-gap:5.6px;width:80%}@media (min-width: 500px){.cds-popup-content{width:400px}}@media (max-width: 499px) and (min-width: 451px){.cds-popup-content{max-width:273px}}@media (max-height: 430px){.cds-popup-content{max-width:231px}}.cds-image{width:100%;display:block;margin:0 auto}.cds-close-icon{color:white;font-size:20px;font-weight:normal;position:absolute;top:0px;right:0px;cursor:pointer;background:#333;border:1px solid white;border-radius:50%;padding:3px 7px 3px 7px;line-height:1;z-index:200;transform:translate(0,0)}.cds-close-icon:hover,.cds-close-icon:focus{color:#333;text-decoration:none}.cds-close-icon:active,.cds-close-icon:focus{color:white}.cds-popup-checkbox{display:none}.cds-popup-checkbox+label{font-size:20px;height:28px;display:flex;align-items:center;position:relative;padding-left:35px;cursor:pointer}.cds-popup-checkbox+label:before{border-radius:50%;opacity:0.5;width:22px;height:22px;top:0px;left:0px;border:3px solid rgb(255,255,255);content:"";display:block;position:absolute}.cds-popup-checkbox+label:after{transform:rotate(-45deg);opacity:0.5;border-left:3px solid rgb(255,255,255);border-bottom:3px solid rgb(255,255,255);width:12px;height:6px;left:6px;top:8px;content:"";display:block;position:absolute}.cds-popup-checkbox:checked+label:before{background:rgb(0,128,174);border-color:rgb(0,128,174);opacity:1}.cds-popup-checkbox:checked+label:after{border-left:3px solid rgb(255,255,255);border-bottom:3px solid rgb(255,255,255);opacity:1}.cds-imp{display:none}
